{{Quote|Magus Jocle claimed to find strong emanations of the Force from the Death Star debris. I feel certain that my own presence there have caused this. But I would be foolish not to be certain.|Darth Vader, to his agent|<ref name="SWG:DVI" />}}
'''Magus Jocle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] leader who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Jocle based himself out of a [[Dark Jedi Hideout|hideout]] in the [[Swamp of Fallen Stars]], an area of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] which served as a graveyard for much of the debris of the destroyed [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], better known as the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. Eager to learn more about the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] who destroyed the Death Star, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tasked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] with delivering a piece of the Death Star debris to Magus Jocle so that he and his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] underlings could use their abilities to read the debris for an imprint of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Not willing to draw the ire of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Jocle agreed to help, and concluded that the debris was giving off strong emanations of the Force. With his usefulness exhausted, Vader instructed his agent to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Magus Jocle thereafter, in order to eliminate any trail of his inquiries. Regardless, the information gleaned from this investigative work eventually helped [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader reach the conclusion that the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] responsible for destroying the Death Star was none other than his own [[Skywalker family/Legends|son]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Your usefulness is at an end!"<br />"I should have expected such treachery!|Vader's agent and Magus Jocle, just moments before fighting each other|<ref name="SWG:DVI" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] by the name of Magus Jocle lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWG:DVI" /> When the famed Rebel Alliance [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|hero]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> debris of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] rained onto the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Much of the debris ended up in a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] which became known as the [[Swamp of Fallen Stars]]. Magus Jocle, along with a sizeable retinue of fellow [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] underlings, inhabited a [[Dark Jedi Hideout|hidden enclave]] within the swamp. Meanwhile, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was on assignment at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where he became obsessed with discovering the identity of the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] who destroyed the Death Star.<ref name="SWG:DVI" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
To that end, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader enlisted the help of an Imperial operative to chase down various leads. During the course of the investigation, the Imperial operative traveled to Yavin 4 to confront two Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Demaia Maru]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Osto Elrad]]. Before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agent]], the Rebels told a story of a young boy from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who possessed the powers of a Jedi. Darth Vader dismissed this as a hoax as he himself had scoured the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier and found no trace of anyone with the slightest [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. Regardless, Vader was interested in pursuing this lead, and instructed his operative to collect a fragment of the Death Star which entered through Yavin 4's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Knowing of the nearby enclave of Dark Jedi, Vader further instructed his operative to deliver the debris to their hideout, and convince the Dark Jedi to pool their abilities and read the debris of the Death Star for an imprint of the boy who had been given credit for its destruction. This was no simple task, as the Dark Jedi were aggressive, and attacked the Imperial agent as soon as they entered their enclave. However, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader's agent was a capable fighter, and managed to fight their way through the Dark Jedi minions to the lower, inner sanctum of the hideout, where Magus Jocle could be found.<ref name="SWG:DVI" />

Unlike his accomplices, Magus Jocle was pragmatic, and unwilling to die at Vader's hand. He refrained from attacking Vader's agent, did as he was asked, and inspected the Death Star debris, which he claimed gave off strong emanations of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Jocle had fulfilled his purpose, but Vader was unwilling to show any mercy to the Devaronian. Not wishing to leave a trail of his inquiries, Vader instructed his agent to kill Jocle once his usefulness had been exhausted. As soon as the agent began attacking him, Jocle expressed his dismay, admitting that he should have expected such treachery. Jocle ignited his single-bladed [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and began [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fighting back]], but to no avail. Despite his knowledge of the Force, and his skill with the lightsaber, Jocle was bested by his Imperial adversary and killed.<ref name="SWG:DVI" />

With Jocle eliminated, Vader's operative returned to the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] Retreat on Naboo to report news of the success. Vader felt certain that the Force emanations Magus Jocle detected from the fallen Death Star debris must have been caused by his own presence during the Battle of Yavin. However, Vader admitted that it would have been foolish not to be certain. Vader eventually dispatched his agent to [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|Ben Kenobi's hut]] on Tatooine, the former home of legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. There, a strong lingering of the Force was detected through the use of a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] recovered from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The crystal detected not just the strong lingering of the Force from Obi-Wan, but also another yet unidentified Force imprint from none other than Vader's own [[Skywalker family/Legends|son]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Vader was at first puzzled by this revelation, and gave much thought regarding the identity of the mysterious Force-user.<ref name="SWG:DVI" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Hmmph. I am not at anyone's bidding. But I also do not wish to die at Vader's hand. I can be pragmatic. I will do as he asks.|Magus Jocle, to Vader's agent|<ref name="SWG:DVI" />}}
Magus Jocle had red skin, and yellow colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. A proud individual, Jocle did not wish to submit to anyone. However, unlike his underlings, he could be pragmatic. When the operative sent by Vader asked for his services, Jocle did not decline, realizing that opposing the Dark Lord of the Sith would not be a sensible solution. However, his professed sense of pragmatism would actually prove to be his downfall. Despite obliging the demands of Vader and his agent, he was still killed off, in order to eliminate any trail of inquiries.<ref name="SWG:DVI" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a practitioner of the dark side of the Force, Magus Jocle was capable of using [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. He was also a capable duelist, as evidenced by his use of a lightsaber. However, neither his use of the Force nor his skill with a lightsaber were enough to save him from an untimely demise at the hands of Vader's Imperial operative.<ref name="SWG:DVI" />

==Equipment==
[[File:MagusLightsaber.jpg|190px|thumb|Magus Jocle's lightsaber]]
During his time as a Dark Jedi, Magus Jocle possessed and made use of a one handed lightsaber with a glowing red energy blade. The cylindrical handle of Jocle's [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] was strongly reminiscent<ref name="SWG:DVI" /> of the one fashioned for [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber]].<ref name="ANH" /> During his time at the hidden enclave on Yavin 4, Jocle wore a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Robe/Legends|robe]] and dark colored [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="SWG:DVI" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Hmmph. I am not at anyone's bidding. But I also do not wish to die at Vader's hand. I can be pragmatic. I will do as he asks."<br />"Thank you."<br />"Hmmph.|Dialogue between Magus Jocle and the player, when the player opted not to attack Jocle|<ref name="SWG:DVI" />}}
Magus Jocle was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DVI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

[[File:TemplateSomDarkJediMinion.jpg|250px|thumb|Original depictions of Magus Jocle, deemed non-canon in Legends]]
With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update on [[September 12]], [[2007]], the [[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]] was revamped with new [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]] and content.<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> Magus Jocle was featured in one of these new quests, titled "[[W:c:swg:Darth Vader's Inquiries|Darth Vader's Inquiries: Part II]]." In the quest, [[W:c:swg:Darth Vader|Darth Vader]] tasked players with traveling to [[W:c:swg:Yavin IV|Yavin 4]] to complete a number of tasks, including fighting and killing Jocle. In the conversation prompt with Jocle, it was possible for players to select an option to peacefully leave Jocle alone. However, the quest progression necessitated killing Jocle, therefore this article assumes 100% [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|game]] completion. Originally, Jocle was known to spawn under a randomized "som_dark_jedi_minion" template, which included various depictions, including a male [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]], and a female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]. Some point later, Magus Jocle's appearance template was updated to permanently appear as a male [[W:c:swg:Devaronian|Devaronian]]. This article assumes the updated depiction to be [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="SWG:DVI" />
